notes: Huainan, Ying Bu's Han vassal kingdom, -203..-196. 3 pages opened (Ying Bu; Eighteen Kingdoms; Changsha Kingdom for Yuzhang). Cliopatria's Jiujiang (-206..-204) is the earlier kingdom of the same man; ea-02-b's jiujiang dossier ends in 204 (Long Ju). Unsettled: the Ying Bu page gives no territory table of its own beyond the four commanderies; the Eighteen Kingdoms page has no Huainan row; the capital while King of Jiujiang is not named; the later Han Kingdom of Huainan (Liu Chang, from 196) is not dossiered. Counterparts: han-dynasty, jiujiang exist; changsha-kingdom is written by this batch.
